known_limits: Polling cannot observe jobs that start and finish between polls.
The SDK has no atomic check-and-close operation; a job can start after the final recheck.
Run matching is an estimate within 90 seconds; incomplete indexes or missing timezone-aware creation times suppress links.
Temperature history covers only recorded polls within 24 hours, capped at 256 sensors; display is downsampled with extrema and gaps.
Sensor mapping was measured on one hardware/software combination and remains unverified when populated slots disagree.
Admin and hardware sensor behavior were validated with fake fixtures matching the measured response shapes; SaaS verified cleanup end to end.
The regression-test interpreter had a TLS root-certificate problem for SaaS; the first-build SDK interpreter successfully verified cleanup.
